title: cnv
my_canvas

methods.description: sets the size of selectable square
sets font type <0: DejaVu Sans Mono, 1: Helvetica, 2: Times> and font size
first element sets background color and third sets font color (either floats or symbols in hexadecimal format)
sets position in the patch canvas
changes the position by a x/y delta in pixels
gets objects' position (sent to a receive name)

body: [cnv] is a canvas GUI, a colored rectangle used as a background or to show a label. It has no inlets or outlets, so it communicates through its send and receive names, and it can report its position when asked. Right click on its top left corner for properties.
